test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Any female animal which feeds its young on milk from her own body
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mammal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **mammal **is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk from its own body. (स्तनपायी एक प्रकार का जानवर है जो अपने बच्चों को अपने शरीर से दूध पिलाता है)
 
• The word "mammal" comes from the Latin word "mamma," which means "breast" or "udder."
 
• All mammals have hair or fur and are warm-blooded.
 
• Examples of mammals include dogs, cats, cows, and humans.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Vertebrate **refers to any animal with a backbone, including mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fish. (कशेरुकी जंतु से तात्पर्य रीढ़ की हड्डी वाले किसी भी जानवर से है)
 
• **Parasite **refers to an organism that lives on or in another organism and feeds off of it, often causing harm. (परजीवी एक ऐसे जीव को संदर्भित करता है जो किसी अन्य जीव पर या उसमें रहता है और उसे खाता है, जो अक्सर नुकसान पहुंचाता है)
 
• **Fauna **refers to all of the animal life in a particular region or time period. (जीव-जंतु से तात्पर्य किसी विशेष क्षेत्र या समय अवधि में सभी पशु जीवन से है)
